title: Weight and trade-offs
about: Why engineers can't have everything, and how a weight limit forces choices.

html: Engineers can't have everything. Every choice gives something and costs something.
That's called a trade-off. In Bot Arena, every part has a weight, and the motors can only carry 75 kg.
Heavy parts like Treads and the Hammer are strong. But you can't put every strong part on one robot.

steps.q: Treads (40 kg) + Camera (10 kg) + Hammer (30 kg) = 80 kg. That's too heavy. Which change does NOT fix it?
options: Swap the Camera for Touch (2 kg)
Swap the Hammer for a Spinner (20 kg)
Swap the Aggressive brain for the Smart brain
Swap the Treads for Legs (30 kg)
steps.explain: Brains weigh 0 kg, so swapping brains doesn't change the weight. All the other swaps get under 75 kg.

options: A part that is always the best
Getting more of one thing by giving up some of another
steps.explain: Like Treads: more armor, but slower and heavier. Every part in the game is a trade-off.
